purpose: Machine-readable source registry for VIN, chassis, and OEM lookup routing.

sources.name: NHTSA vPIC API
sources.notes: Primary VIN decode source for regulated vehicles. Supports decode and manufacturer data.

sources.name: NHTSA vPIC Home
sources.notes: Official home for VIN decoding, MID, and downloadable standalone datasets.

sources.notes: Documents Toyota Japan catalog inputs including VIN and frame number search flow.

sources.name: Nissan EPC Mirror

sources.name: Nissan Recall Search
